what: Low hero shot of the FUNFAIR FRENZY entrance gate arch from the forecourt spawn pad; the coin trail leads through the arch toward the lobby park map and START stairs.
Wider symmetric view of the FUNFAIR FRENZY gate arch with pennant flags, string lights, balloons and a food cart; the lobby shows through the arch.
Lobby plaza: fountain, the FUNFAIR FRENZY park map listing all six zones, the changing room, START stairs, balloon arch, a food stall and the zone 1 course behind.
The lobby changing room: a ring of mannequins wearing costumes (Mouse Ears, Party Cone, Clown Wig, Top Hat, Crown, capes, trails) with the Champion Cape shown as the reward.
Zone 1 Grand Gate Plaza: the big top circus tent behind its GRAND GATE PLAZA arch, with the zone's switchback course stacked on columns beside it.
Zone 2 Carousel Corner: the carousel with its horses and CAROUSEL CORNER arch; carousel-themed course stages climb on pink columns to the right.
Zone 3 Sparkle Bumper Arena: the BUMPER CARS canopy with cars on the floor behind the zone arch; the course runs in stacked layers on blue columns behind it.
Zone 4 Twirly Teacup Terrace: pastel teacups around a teapot under a striped canopy, with the zone's START tower and climbing course behind.
Zone 5 Starlight Ferris Wheel: the Ferris wheel with colourful gondolas above its entrance arch; the zone's course layers stack on orange columns to the right.
Zone 6 Skyburst Finale Summit: the FIREWORKS stage with SHOW TONIGHT signs while bursts go off over the stacked course.
The hub drop tower rising from its fountain plaza, ringed by string lights, umbrellas, balloons and food stalls.
Medium-high view over Grand Gate Plaza and Carousel Corner: the big top and the carousel with both zones' courses stacked on columns between them.
The player's character on the stage 4 checkpoint in Grand Gate Plaza, under the stage arch; the LEMONADE LAVA sign and stages 5, 8 and 9 climb ahead, the big top below.
The player in the Party Cone on the stage 51 checkpoint of Skyburst Finale Summit while fireworks burst overhead.
The player wearing the Party Cone, bought with coins from the lobby coin trail, in front of the changing room mannequins.
The ride gate at the end of zone 1 reading RIDE TO CAROUSEL CORNER, with the whole Grand Gate Plaza course and the big top behind it.
